correctness.rationale: Four direction types characterize acyclicity exactly; orientation-sink weights correctly include the exceptional two-hub-sink state. Exclude all real roots >=-2 except simple 0 via coefficient positivity and a uniform inequality. For x>0 after z=-2-x, use Descartes sign patterns: one positive root for even n>=4, exactly two for odd n>=5 by a positive x=3 witness and negative endpoints; n=2 and n=3 are checked symbolically. Independent brute-force acyclic counts match every coefficient through n=8; exact-integer sign tests corroborate up to n=200; these are corroborations rather than infinite proofs.
